What's made your dev life easier?

Starting a new role as a sr. frontend at a SaaS company and I have a moment to breathe and think about my dev environment, both on and off-screen. 

It's been a solid 7 years since I've taken time to consider changing much about my remote office / environment setup.

Currently... 

Hardware: 
- Macbook (no extra screen)
- Some wired earbuds
- Standing desk
- Desk treadmill (my beloved)
- Yeti rambler for hot drinks

Software: 
- I use multiple desktops that are static containing different applications and terminals I need. I switch between them all with swipe gestures. 
- iterm2, ohmyzsh (RobbyRussel) with a host of little aliases (mainly for git and proprietary system management)
- VScode (mainly for conformity with other dev teams)
- Docker desktop (I hear orbstack may be better)
- Notion for docs (unless the team uses something else)
